title: Vendor Contract Clause Requirements
description: Synthetic clause checklist for reviewing Acme Corp vendor agreements.

requirements.title: Indemnification clause
requirements.requirement: Vendor contracts must include indemnification protection for third-party claims, confidentiality breaches, data protection failures, and vendor negligence.

requirements.title: Liability cap
requirements.requirement: Vendor contracts must include a liability cap with explicit carve-outs for confidentiality, data protection, fraud, willful misconduct, and indemnification obligations.

requirements.title: Confidentiality and data protection
requirements.requirement: Vendor contracts must protect confidential information and define data protection obligations when the vendor handles Acme Corp or customer data.

requirements.title: Termination rights
requirements.requirement: Vendor contracts must define termination rights for material breach, insolvency, and convenience where commercially appropriate.

sections.title: Contract review overview
sections.content: Checklist for reviewing Acme Corp vendor agreements against required indemnification, liability cap, confidentiality and data protection, and termination provisions.
